result: {"counter_case": "The headline hit rate does not survive recomputation: 156 hits in 200 runs is 78%, not 87%, so the improvement is 41% to 78%, and the recommendation overstates the gain. The safety claim is also weak. The key now hashes the lockfile alone, so a stale check that compares the restored lockfile hash against the lockfile can only pass, because the key already guarantees that match. It cannot detect caches restored across a different OS, runtime version or architecture, which a lockfile-only key would newly allow and which could explain part of the extra hits. The two samples are also not shown to be comparable (different periods, no control), so the 3.5-minute drop may not come from the key change.
